title: test/golden/manifest.json
description: Tracks golden (baseline) image metadata for @recursica/adapter-tester's golden-image visual regression checks. One manifest lives alongside its adapter's test/golden/<story-id>.png files, keyed by story id.

createdAt.description: When this story's own golden PNG was last captured, via --update-golden, --approve-divergence, or first-run auto-create.

sourceOfTruthCreatedAt.description: The source-of-truth adapter's (mantine) manifest `createdAt` for this story at the time this adapter's divergence from it was last reviewed via --approve-divergence. Omitted on the source-of-truth adapter's own manifest, and omitted here until the first approval. If mantine's current `createdAt` for this story is newer than this value, the divergence is flagged again for re-review.
